vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Ground Elder too.
A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Megan: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Esther, Henry, Nathan and Sari met them at the door — 4 put down. Esther, Henry, Nathan, Sari are hurt.
🛡️ Kieran, Esther and Megan met them at the door — 3 put down. Esther, Megan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🛡️ Kieran, Esther, Megan, Agnieszka and Henry met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Esther, Megan, Agnieszka, Henry are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Esther, Megan, Agnieszka and Henry met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Esther, Megan, Agnieszka are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kieran just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
The Pack-leader The Callback wears Carlos's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Callback (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
You fling a handful of grit into The Pack-leader The Callback's eyes. It reels, clawing at its face — half-blind for 2 rounds. (Pocket Sand: attacks at disadvantage.)
The Pack-leader The Callback falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Callback!

regDeaths.name: a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
